paragraphs: Markets over the last day: the eight tracked equity indices moved +1.69% on average, with Nasdaq strongest (+2.31%) and Nikkei 225 weakest (+0.86%). Brent crude changed -3.98% to 90.84. Gold changed +3.75% to 3,668.5. Bitcoin changed -0.95% to 59,920.5. The US 10-year yield stands at 4.936%, a relative move of +1.82%. Among the firms tracked, Gold Miners (ETF) (+7.16%) and Newmont (+5.35%) moved the most.
